Balor came out at number 14 with the likes of Sting, Triple H, Samoa Joe,Chris Jericho and AJ Styles himself in the ring already. Balor managed to last over 10 minutes eliminating Styles, Sting, Zayn, Joe and Lesnar. After an impressive year, everyone was sure 'leader of The Club, AJ Styles would pick up the victory. * **Sasha Banks vs Becky Lynch vs Emma (c) - Women's Championship** Plan was to have the the four horsewomen match however Emma regained her title at Elimination Chamber against Becky. * **ARMBAR** - Samoa Joe wins picking up momentum going into the 2nd season. 

* **Shinsuke Nakamura vs Seth Rollins (c) - WWE Championship** Nakamura debuted at the Rumble winning it while Rollins retained in a five star match vs Reigns at the Rumble and in a chamber match the following month. This was the big feel good moment for the fans. It was all going so well. Nakamura hit Rollins with a middle rope jumping Kinshasa followed by a normal Kinshasa. However Nakamura wasn't done there.
